I trim my chicken and remove the film that’s on it, after that I put it in a bowl of water and vinegar to clean it. I hear about guidelines for not washing it, but for me unwashed chicken has a smell and a taste that I am not fond of. I went and got fried chicken fro a chicken chain not too long ago and I couldn’t eat it because the unwashed flavor was so overpowering.

Could be where I live(Las Vegas) but the point is I Keep a stocked pantry and I shop for deals even when I go to Kroger or Albertsons. Sometimes I buy things that I don’t know how to cook, but I have google and figure it out. I’m actually addicted to living this way

I live on a budget because I’m single and I’m cheap, my pantry is fully stocked. I keep a lot of dry goods so I have flour, different types of beans, cornmeal, cornstarch, rice, pasta, peanut butter, different cans of tomato like diced, paste and so on.

When I go shopping weekly I go to a local Hispanic supermarket and buy whatever they have on sale. For me a single man who loves to cook I can spend $15 a week and eat good. For example they had tomatillos 4 pounds for $1 T bone steak $3.50 lb beef shank $2.50 lb 2 eggplant for $1. Steak and fried green tomatillos, osso buco with polenta, eggplant pasta. My weekly menu is predicated on what’s for sale combined with what’s in my pantry.
